title: Rule Book button exists but #ruleBook text is missing from index.html
steps: Open index.html on main and locate the Rule Book menu button.
Scan the full index.html for a section with id="ruleBook" and its rule text.
Compare the visible season scoring hint with js/scoring.js and the allowed season counts with js/showdown.js.
expected: index.html contains #ruleBook with the competition rules, so the written Rule Book can be checked directly against the gameplay code.
actual: index.html contains #ruleBookButton but no #ruleBook section or Rule Book text. The scoring hint that is present matches the scoring implementation, but the requested Rule Book source is absent.
root_cause: The Rule Book markup/text is not present in index.html on main.

fix.change: Restore or add the #ruleBook section in index.html and make its season length, transfer, scoring, tie and final-winner wording match the current gameplay rules.

assumptions: A later runtime module may generate a Rule Book screen dynamically; that module was not read because the chat check is capped at four code files. Even if it does, #ruleBook is still absent from the required index.html source.
